# The shell scripts this tree still tracks (TestNoShellScriptsShip): one path per
# line, shrink-only. A line whose file is gone, or is no longer a shell script,
# fails the test: delete the line with the file. A new line is a refusal; the
# remedy is a Go verb or a Go test binary fake.
#
# The scripted children of the card contract's end-to-end test. Each is read by
# cmd/nova-swarm/contract_functional_test.go (scriptFor) and named in
# docs/SPEC-CARD-CONTRACT.md; replacing them with Go test binaries edits both.
